map.校验合同签订日、生效日、终止日的逻辑合理性，计算合同期限，并判断合同当前状态。: Checks the logical consistency of the signing date, effective date and end date, computes the contract term and determines the current contract status.
map.📖 查看「合同日期校验 使用指南」: 📖 View the guide to contract date validation
map.普通履行期校验：签订 2024-01-10、生效 2024-02-01、终止 2: Standard performance period: signed 2024-01-10, effective 2024-02-01, ending 2025-01-31, a term of 365 days (about 1 year); while it is in performance the remaining days and progress can be shown.
map.生效日晚于签订日：签订 2024-03-01、生效 2024-06-01，工具提: Effective date later than the signing date: signed 2024-03-01 and effective 2024-06-01, the tool notes that it takes effect 92 days after signing, avoiding effectiveness disputes caused by logical contradictions.
map.约定提前通知终止：终止日 2025-12-31、需提前 30 天通知，最后通知日: Advance notice agreed for termination: with an end date of 2025-12-31 and 30 days advance notice required, the last notice date is 2025-12-01; missing it may make unilateral termination under the agreement impossible.
map.算例：一年期合同期限换算: Worked example: converting a one-year contract term
map.生效 2024-02-01、终止 2025-01-31，期限 = 2025-01: Effective 2024-02-01 and ending 2025-01-31, so the term = 2025-01-31 − 2024-02-01 = 365 days. If today is 2024-06-10, then 130 days have been performed, 235 days remain and progress is about 35.6%; status: today falls within the interval [effective date, end date] → in performance. For the notice period, 30 days before the end date 2025-12-31 gives 2025-12-01 as the last notice date.
map.生效日早于签订日有什么风险？: What is the risk of an effective date earlier than the signing date?
map.除非约定附条件或附期限生效，否则生效日早于签订日存在逻辑矛盾，可能影响合同效力起: Unless the contract is agreed to take effect subject to a condition or a term, an effective date earlier than the signing date is logically contradictory and may affect when the contract takes effect; check the clauses before signing.
map.自动续期条款如何呈现？: How is an automatic renewal clause presented?
map.勾选“约定自动续期”后，到期状态显示为“已自动续期”，应提示核对续展次数上限与续: Once you check automatic renewal agreed, the expiry status is shown as automatically renewed, and you should be prompted to verify the cap on the number of renewals and the renewal conditions to avoid disputes over indefinite renewal.
